claims.assertion: Mari Swa describes walk-ins as souls entering an existing Earth body, either through soul agreements or immersion technology.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as an extraterrestrial account.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa alleges that some extraterrestrial actors manipulate walk-ins through identity claims, altered photographs, and implanted memories.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says such contact can also interfere with a person’s plans.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa warns that claims about past lives and extraterrestrial identity can be used to gaslight vulnerable people.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She advises judging reality using the best available information.

review_flags: The video explicitly frames its extraterrestrial and immersion-technology claims as entertainment; they are unverified.
coverage_gaps: The video also discusses past-life memory, Moon-related frequency claims, and alleged advanced image fabrication.
